description: Richtek RT9080 (DS9080-05, June 2017): 2uA IQ, 600mA LDO with enable, 1.2-5.5V input. Ordering code RT9080-33GJ5 = 3.3V fixed, J5 = TSOT-23-5, G = green, no SNS pin variant (RT9080 not RT9080N), so pin 4 is NC.

pinout.name: VIN
pinout.notes: Supply input, 1.2V to 5.5V operating (Recommended Operating Conditions); abs max -0.3V to 6.5V.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.notes: Enable control input, CMOS logic; VIH 0.9V min, VIL 0.4V max (VIN = 5V). Cannot be left floating; may be tied directly to VIN to keep the part on (Application Information > Enable). IEN 0.1uA max at 5.5V.

pinout.name: NC
pinout.notes: Pin table: pin 4 is SNS on the RT9080N (with SNS) and NC ('No internal connection') on the RT9080 (without SNS). RT9080-33GJ5 has no N suffix, so this is NC.

pinout.name: VOUT
pinout.notes: Regulated output (3.3V fixed for -33). Output Voltage Range 0.8-3.3V per Electrical Characteristics; +/-2% accuracy at 1mA.

decoupling.placement: input, VIN to GND, close to the IC's VIN and GND pins
decoupling.notes: Application Information: 'Use a 1uF or larger input capacitor and place it close to the IC's VIN and GND pins.' Figures 1-2 show CIN = 1uF.

decoupling.placement: output, VOUT to GND, close to the IC's VOUT and GND pins
decoupling.notes: Application Information: any output capacitor meeting the minimum 1mOhm ESR and effective capacitance larger than 1uF may be used (effective = after temperature and voltage coefficient derating). Stable with ceramic or tantalum. Increasing capacitance and decreasing ESR improves PSRR and line transient response. Operation section: minimum 1uF effective capacitance.

land_pattern.notes: The datasheet has NO recommended land pattern drawing; only the package outline (p.13): body B 1.397-1.803 mm, D (length) 2.692-3.099 mm, C (overall width over leads) 2.591-3.000 mm, lead width b 0.300-0.559 mm, lead pitch e 0.838-1.041 mm (min/max range only, no nominal), lead length L 0.300-0.610 mm, height A 0.700-1.000 mm. Pad size and pitch for the footprint are NOT given in the datasheet. Pins 1-3 on one side, 4-5 on the other (pin config, top view: pin 5 VOUT and pin 4 NC above, pin 1 VIN, 2 GND, 3 EN below).

layout_notes: Place the input capacitor (1uF or larger) close to the IC's VIN and GND pins (Application Information).
Place the output capacitor close to the IC's VOUT and GND pins; effective capacitance after DC-bias and temperature derating must stay >= 1uF and ESR >= 1mOhm.
EN pin must not float: tie to VIN (always on) or drive from a defined logic level (VIH >= 0.9V, VIL <= 0.4V).
Pin 4 is NC on this part (no SNS function); no connection is required.

Thermal: theta-JA is 230.6 C/W for TSOT-23-5 on a JEDEC 51-7 four-layer test board and theta-JC 21.8 C/W; theta-JA is layout dependent (Thermal Considerations). Maximum power dissipation PD(MAX) = (125C - TA)/theta-JA = 0.43W at TA = 25C; derate with ambient temperature (Fig. 6). Power dissipated is (VIN - VOUT) x IOUT, so a lower VIN keeps the part cool.
Dropout (VIN - VOUT at VOUT = 98%, ILOAD = 600mA): 0.31V typ / 0.53V max for VOUT >= 3V, so 3.3V output needs VIN >= about 3.83V at full 600mA; 600mA output is specified for VIN >= 2.3V.
Over-temperature protection trips at 150C typ (output current above 80mA) with 20C hysteresis; current limit 1.1A typ, fold-back about 0.6A; output can be shorted to ground indefinitely.
Output discharge: 80 Ohm typ discharge resistance when EN = 0V, so the output is actively pulled down in shutdown.
The datasheet gives no layout section, copper-pour guidance, or recommended land pattern beyond the items above.

abs_max.param: VIN, VOUT, SNS, EN to GND
